diagnosis.input_abstraction: possible_regions adds static possible target addresses beyond the one concrete region; read and write choices are independent overapproximations
diagnosis.justification: Every extra value and extra may-taint has equation-level initial-memory/write origins; supplying precise actual read/write addresses removes all155 approximations without changing concrete schedules or observations
diagnosis.limitation: This does not prove the implementation universally bug-free. The controls grant additional address knowledge and are not a generic alias-analysis improvement; separate correlation/Top regressions remain.
